mapper.insert: INSERT INTO topic_reply (topic_id, user_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{topicId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT tr.*, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM topic_reply tr LEFT JOIN user u ON tr.user_id = u.id WHERE tr.topic_id = #{topicId} ORDER BY tr.create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_reply WHERE topic_id = #{topicId}
SELECT tr.*, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM topic_reply tr LEFT JOIN user u ON tr.user_id = u.id WHERE tr.topic_id = #{topicId} AND tr.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY tr.create_time ASC
